name: downshock_cushion_absorb
description: Daily OHLC downshock-cushion absorption factor. It activates when an asset has an unusually large open-to-low downside probe versus its own trailing history, then rewards stocks that close materially above the intraday low. The final value is a same-date cross-sectional centered rank of the gated cushion strength.
pit_assumption: The factor is formed after the close of date t and uses only date t or earlier data. The downside shock threshold is an asset-grouped trailing 60-trading-day rolling 70th percentile with min_periods=20, evaluated through date t. The off-low cushion uses same-day OHLC from date t. Cross-sectional ranking uses only securities on the same date t.
code:
def build_factor(frame):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    factor_name = "downshock_cushion_absorb"
    required = ["date", "asset", "open", "high", "low", "close"]
    missing = [c for c in required if c not in frame.columns]
    if missing:
        return pd.Series(np.nan, index=frame.index, name=factor_name)

    work = frame[required].copy()
    work["_orig_pos"] = np.arange(len(work))
    work["date"] = pd.to_datetime(work["date"], errors="coerce")

    for col in ["open", "high", "low", "close"]:
        work[col] = pd.to_numeric(work[col], errors="coerce")

    work = work.sort_values(["asset", "date", "_orig_pos"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    opn = work["open"]
    high = work["high"]
    low = work["low"]
    close = work["close"]

    valid_ohlc = (
        opn.gt(0)
        & high.notna()
        & low.notna()
        & close.notna()
        & high.ge(low)
        & close.ge(low)
        & close.le(high)
    )

    price_range = high - low
    down = pd.Series(np.nan, index=work.index, dtype="float64")
    off_low = pd.Series(np.nan, index=work.index, dtype="float64")

    valid_range = valid_ohlc & price_range.gt(0)
    down.loc[valid_range] = ((opn.loc[valid_range] - low.loc[valid_range]) / opn.loc[valid_range]).clip(lower=0.0)
    off_low.loc[valid_range] = ((close.loc[valid_range] - low.loc[valid_range]) / price_range.loc[valid_range]).clip(0.0, 1.0)

    down_q = (
        down.groupby(work["asset"], sort=False)
        .rolling(window=60, min_periods=20)
        .quantile(0.70)
        .reset_index(level=0, drop=True)
    )

    ready = valid_range & down.notna() & off_low.notna() & down_q.notna()
    raw = pd.Series(np.nan, index=work.index, dtype="float64")
    raw.loc[ready] = 0.0
    shock = ready & down.ge(down_q)
    raw.loc[shock] = down.loc[shock] * off_low.loc[shock]

    ranked = raw.groupby(work["date"], sort=False).rank(pct=True, method="average")
    value = ranked - ranked.groupby(work["date"], sort=False).transform("mean")
    value = value.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    out = pd.Series(np.nan, index=frame.index, name=factor_name, dtype="float64")
    out.iloc[work["_orig_pos"].to_numpy()] = value.to_numpy()
    return out
